LESSON: EQUATIONS OF A STRAIGHT LINE

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: GRADE
Strand: ALGEBRA
Topic 2.2: Equations of a Straight Line
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 15

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Equations of a Straight Line, part of ALGEBRA in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: How do we use gradient or steepness in our daily activities?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Equations of a Straight Line together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: Operates digital devices and uses the internet; A learner accesses learning materials using digital devices with

assistive technology or other resources to explore steepness or gradients of places.

● Learning to learn: Sets their own goal; A learner builds on their own learning experiences as they place the ladder at different

points on the ground while discussing and comparing steepness.

Values:
Integrity: A learner enhances discipline as they observe gradient/steepness in staircases in buildings, bridges or ramps.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Socio-Economic and Environmental Issues: Safety and security; A learner promotes awareness as they climb up and down

places such as the stairs or hills and relate to gradients.

Link to other learning areas:

● Integrated Science: A learner uses the ladder to make work easier by using different gradients.

Suggested resources

● Rulers, drawing tools, graph papers/ squared books, ladder, pictures
